conclusions.topic: Decap B-PT+S-MG: Primer/Lumix vs alcohol normal
conclusions.statement_from_report: Decap Bond BPT+SM Clean Primer NG 4/6pcs 66.7%, Clean Lumix NG 4/6pcs 66.7%, alcohol 0/6.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: 2025-10-13: Primer 66.67% vs Normal 0% — Primer worse by infinity (failure). Lumix 66.67% vs Normal 0% — same failure. 2025-10-16: Primer 16.67% vs Normal 0% — still worse, Lumix 66.67% vs Normal 0% — still failure. Both cleaners weaken B-PT+S-MG decap bond strength below alcohol baseline.
Primer 0.65% vs Normal 1.02% = 0.633x, 36.7% improved (small sample). Lumix 1.28% vs Normal 1.02% = 1.26x, 25.7% worse. Vision separate is roughly comparable to baseline.

Long SM: Primer 53.24 vs Normal 43.82 = +21.5%; Lumix 43.54 vs Normal 43.82 ~ no change. Short SM: Primer 28.77 vs Normal 26.16 = +10.0%; Lumix 31.63 vs Normal 26.16 = +20.9%. C-MG: Primer 183.24 vs Normal 183.65 ~ flat; Lumix 195.01 vs Normal 183.65 = +6.2%. Tension is comparable or slightly higher than normal.
Despite tension and vision being acceptable, decap bond B-PT+S-MG fails the 80-90% spec with both cleaners on both events. Author rejects adoption.

suggested_checks.check_item: Do not adopt Primer AS 8100 or Lumix 840 for C-MG/S-MG cleaning
suggested_checks.reason: Decap NG 16.7%-66.7% vs Normal 0% on two events; bond strength regressed.

suggested_checks.check_item: Maintain alcohol cleaning as baseline for B-PT+S-MG bond
suggested_checks.reason: Alcohol decap NG remained 0/6 on both events.

limitations: Decap sample only 6 pieces per condition, single line, two events.

assumptions: Alcohol cleaning treated as Normal/baseline since spec calls 80-90% bond and alcohol passes.
warnings: Small decap sample size (6 pieces) - high relative variance.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Same-event Normal (alcohol) exists for vision/decap/tension. Decap B-PT+S-MG fails spec with Primer (16.7-66.7%) and Lumix (66.7%), while alcohol passes (0%). Decision = Can not use.
